Free until the driver heads out. After that, the $89 dry-run fee, only if you say yes

Missed and after-hours calls go to Rosie

notes:
From the locksmith pilot (urgent): towing runs like a lockout. A call is sent now to whoever is on call, with an arrival estimate; the driver checks a photo ID and proof of the right to move the car at the scene; a cancel after the truck heads out may cost a trip (dry-run) fee, only if Sam confirms. Its plug-in, ops and splits were reworked for towing; its rename list was replaced by towing's own words.
Flow B's main story is sent now (the caller's ask): Mon Oct 19, 6:40pm, Alex's car won't start on the Route 9 shoulder.
